chain.text:
In the month of April, 1994, after the tragic assassination of our beloved President Habyarimana, a dark chapter unfolded in our homeland, Rwanda. During approximately three months, the majority Hutu population carried out a horrific act against fellow citizens, mainly Tutsis, claiming an estimated 800,000 innocent lives. This catastrophic event, known as the genocide, left deep scars in our hearts and communities, lasting for over a century's worth of days. The carnage came to an end when the Rwandan Patriotic Front (RPF), led by Tutsi forces, managed to seize control of the nation.

This chilling account resonates deeply within me, as I was just twelve years old during those tumultuous times and witnessed the unfathomable loss that engulfed my own family and many others in Kigali. Although we have since striven for reconciliation and unity, with an official policy that prohibits ethnic labels, it is crucial to remember the tragic events of our past so that we may continue to build a brighter future for all Rwandans.

chain.text:
In April of 1994, following the murderous attack on our cherished President Habyarimana, our beloved homeland, Rwanda, was plunged into darkness. For about three painful months, my fellow countrymen - mainly those of Hutu descent - enacted a terrible deed against their own neighbors, mostly Tutsis. This unimaginable act of violence, known as the genocide, is still etched deeply in our hearts and has left scars that will likely take more than a century to heal completely.

As I was only twelve years old during those difficult days, I saw firsthand how this senseless bloodshed claimed countless innocent lives and devastated families, including my own. While we have made efforts towards healing and unity, it is crucial for us to remember the tragic events of our past so that we can work together to create a better future for all Rwandans, where ethnic labels no longer divide us.

chain.text:
Mwanaume mwacu n'Butare, Celestin ya 46-imiyo. N'abasombone 1994 ni mwacu twa ibandi bagenzi. Umwami w'Ebishoborwa Habyarimana rero umunyarwanda umujyi wa muzamiriro kuko kwitira ukubera imbona y'ibigwa n'ingabo z'ibyikorwa. Umunyarwo mu mugabo wacu, bazabwira z'Hutu bazi cyangwa Tutsi, cyane n'umugoroba ry'ukuri kwitira ibicuruzi byose, kubera umunyamana y'inganza ya genocida. Ukubera wa mugabo wacu umujya imigongo ya mwiza zimwe n'ibaragira. Ngo mu mwacu 12 ya ntarama, abandi barashyikirwa ku muri y'umuntu ry'ukuri kubera umunyarwo byose ndetse ku mugabo w'Imana cyane kubera ibyo byose, umuziranko ry'Umurimo n'Ibishobwa. Ngo mu Rwanda, tuziwe na ukuri wa gukora rya kuko tuza fana ibyitso za mwiza y'inganza yabo, muri imigongo z'ubwo birageje kandi ntibaragira.

Murakoze Cyane!
